title: Plants and grazers
hook: Follow a small stated change in plant cover.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy plot, 12 plant patches start present. Grazers consume 3 patches in one scenario and 7 in another; no patches regrow. Which scenario leaves more?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: In a toy plot, 12 plant patches start present. Grazers consume 3 patches in one scenario and 7 in another; no patches regrow. Which scenario leaves more?

claims.text: In a toy plot, 12 plant patches start present. Grazers consume 3 patches in one scenario and 7 in another; no patches regrow. Which scenario leaves more? The stipulated plot leaves 12 − 3 = 9 patches in A and 12 − 7 = 5 in B. This is a bookkeeping example, not a prediction for a real grazing system.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
A toy plot starts with 10 patches. If 4 are consumed and none regrow, how many remain? Ten initial patches minus four consumed leaves six.
